selected_policy: living inactive side-rest → activation → active battle; deactivation inverse overlay

findings.entry: Inactive proximity/target wake and selected damage wake choose one of two activate clips and set synced ACTIVE true immediately, but active-tick outer guard excludes both activation clips. Else branch stops navigation, sets horizontal velocity0 and holds body yaw. Crystal theft is read only as an entry condition, no accessory work.
findings.guard: AnimationActivateAI/DeactivateAI extend SimpleAnimationAI → AnimationAI; default flags MOVE+LOOK, canContinue tests same animation and tick<duration. stop sends NO_ANIMATION only if current animation still matches; subclass then assigns public entity.active. This public field assignment is not the synced ACTIVE setter; getActive refreshes it from entity data. Interruption callback must not be simplified into an unconditional synced state transition.
findings.parent_end: MowzieLLibraryEntity increments animation tick; client clears clip at >=duration. Server AnimationAI guard/stop source read, but AnimationHandler/network consumer and scheduler timing not closed; do not assert exact cross-client tick.
findings.initial_pose: Both activation clips seed the same zero-duration relative side-rest target, independently equal to direct inactive base assignments after removing line comments. Repeated same-bone rotations/moves accumulate rather than overwrite.
findings.with_crystal: 0–5 hand-controller release,5–15 hold;15–22 asymmetric upper-body/hand/head response,22–24 hold;24–29 changed arm/waist/head preparation,29–36 hold;36–51 unroll root and return supports towards active target;51–55 hold;55–60 jaw/arms roar pose,60–110 hold;110–118 reset. Body root roll is not an actual support-height measurement.
findings.without_crystal: 0–5 hand-controller release,5–15 hold;15–30 coordinated rise;30–34 hold;34–39 roar,39–89 hold;89–97 reset. Declared state100 gives3ticks with no selected relative keyframe transform; this is a neutral target tail, not proof of a bug.
findings.deactivation: When no target for >1200 ticks (or peaceful), not alwaysActive and no current clip, sends DEACTIVATE25 and sets synced ACTIVE false. Inactive base sleep layer now applies; initial inverse target exactly cancels its 20 selected bone/controller channels, then reset20 releases cancellation into side-rest. Last5ticks are selected-relative neutral, while sleeping base/breathing remain. Numerical equality excludes procedural layers.
findings.head_and_hands: HeadJoint is independently counter-posed during rise and participates in inactive breathing. Jaw has its own roar pose and time oscillation. handController is converted to finger/thumb rotations/translations after shared branches; the controller must not be mistaken for a visible bone box or a direct ground point.
findings.overlays: During active activation/deactivation, shared active look/walk/idle block is excluded. Inactive branch excludes activate clips but does not exclude deactivation: side-rest plus chest breathing/head oscillation coexist with deactivation cancellation. Unconditional waist Z+10 and final hand/jaw consumers still apply.
findings.terrain: Model setup always calls Articulator before animation, but entity legSolver updates only active && not activation. Therefore cached support heights can continue affecting inactive/waking poses. Articulator counter-rotates neck relative waist; this is not an explicit head/chin collision solver or exact hand/foot floor lock.
findings.reload: Selected NBT writes active,has_crystal,alwaysActive; spawn packet carries current clip/tick. This does not establish full world-reload wake-progress continuity. Client/server and interruption paths need separate runtime verification.
findings.comparison: BigCat has an early sleeping-flag clear followed by a40step unfold counter and may resume look/gait before shape recovers. Frostmaw holds those layers behind explicit clip guards despite early ACTIVE. This is a different lifecycle organization, not a second species reference for the old Frostmaw owner.

limits: Ape-like hands+feet support, not a four-pawed mammal; only temporal staging is relevant to Suanni.
No complete constructor geometry reconstruction, no head/jaw/paw world-space minima, no rendered model or textured preview.
No runtime, Java, game, sounds, new animation assets or production pose changes.
No guarantee of ground contact, reload continuity, interrupted wake or server/client frame equality.
